data.body:
`finding_decisions()` checks a verdict record's `record_id` prefix with `f"art_v{SCHEMA_VERSION}_"`, but `SCHEMA_VERSION` is not imported anywhere in this module (only `GitHubApiError`, `TelemetryError`, `TelemetryStore`, `VERDICT_OUTCOMES`, `require_finding_id`, `require_finding_key`, `require_identifier`, `require_pull_request_number`, `require_sha`, `require_timestamp`, `validate_record` are imported from `ai_review_telemetry`). Evaluating that f-string raises `NameError: name 'SCHEMA_VERSION' is not defined` for every record that reaches that line — i.e. any syntactically valid `finding_verdict` record for the requested reviewer, which is the normal case once a maintainer has posted `/ai verdict ...`. `main()` only catches `(OSError, TelemetryError, GitHubApiError)`, so the `NameError` propagates uncaught, making `load_ai_review_findings.py` (and therefore `post_ai_review.sh`, which runs under `set -euo pipefail`) crash instead of applying/suppressing anything. This breaks the entire feature as soon as one verdict exists for the reviewer being processed.

Fix: import `SCHEMA_VERSION` from `ai_review_telemetry`.
